He began performing at a young age, and enjoyed being part of many groups including the Christian Rappers. Don Omar's passion for music has served to create a rich fabric of experience and has lead to his contributing to more than 20 Rap albums. Shortly after launching "The Last Don," Don Omar sold more than 350,000 copies and received industry recognition including "Latin Pop Album of the Year" and "New Artist & Latin Rap/Hip-Hop Album of the Year" by the Billboard Latin Music Awards in 2003. The award signified a milestone for Don Omar, VI Music and his management team, Xtreme management, as the album enabled Don Omar to realize his goal of becoming an international artist.
